intro: This quest marks the moment an investigation into sabotage at the Stonewrought Dam uncovers physical evidence of foul play. After discovering a suspicious barrel hidden near the massive dwarven structure, adventurers retrieve a sample of strange smelling powder to bring before Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII.
